head: TriGets: an expense tracker app with no account and no ads
dek: TriGets is a new Android budget app that keeps your income, expenses, budgets and cards in a database on your phone instead of a server, with no account and no ads. The basics are free; bill splitting, trip costs and receipt scanning need the Pro subscription, with a 7-day free trial.
details: It tracks recurring payments, credit card due dates and installments, and shows a balance widget. Backups are encrypted and go to a folder you choose; exports are JSON, CSV or PDF, and a PIN or fingerprint can lock the app. Receipt scanning uses your own AI key (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude or OpenRouter). The developer describes himself as a solo accountant; the app is new, with 10+ downloads on Google Play.
where: Android, Google Play; Pro is a monthly or yearly subscription
means: If you don't want to sign up or hand your spending data to a company just to track a budget, this app keeps it on your phone; you're responsible for your own backups.
todo: Search TriGets on Google Play. If you try Pro, cancel the trial in Google Play's Subscriptions at least 24 hours before it renews if you don't want to pay.
